title: Hanoi in a day
summary: Turtle Tower in the morning, pho in the Hoan Kiem lanes, the citadel before lunch, bun cha around Cua Dong, and the water puppets if the evening is still open.

stops.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
stops.note: Start on the lake path. It is free and open all day. The temple on the island is a separate ticket.

stops.name: Pho
stops.note: Morning bowl in the Hoan Kiem lanes, including Hang Vai. Chili first. Garlic vinegar for beef, lime for chicken.

stops.name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
stops.note: A different morning from the lake. Adult 100,000 VND from 1 January 2025. This ticket is not the mausoleum.

stops.name: Bun cha
stops.note: Lunch around Cua Dong. Put the noodles in with the herbs. Nem is optional.

stops.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
stops.note: 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of the lake. The ticket and the hour are check on arrival.

seoDescription: A one-day Hanoi plan: Hoan Kiem, pho, the citadel, bun cha at lunch, and the water puppets.
